title: Assam is separated from Bengal administration
detail: The British detached Assam from Bengal and created a distinct administrative unit under a Chief Commissioner.

title: Sylhet and Cachar are attached to Assam
detail: Sylhet and Cachar were placed within the Assam administrative framework, altering long-standing Bengal-linked governance patterns.

title: Administrative boundary politics become a recurring issue
detail: The reorganization fed later debates about representation, language, and territorial belonging in eastern Bengal and Assam.
